title: Ryan Dahl: Node JS
summary: Ryan Dahl's JSConf EU talk introducing Node.js to the world. He explains the motivation for event-driven, non-blocking I/O, with JavaScript chosen mainly for its asynchronous nature.
why: Cited as the primary source for why Node exists and why JavaScript was chosen, in debates about async models and language choice.

quote.text: it's kind of refreshing to see the original node.js presentation, where using javascript is sort of a side-note
